column1: # Domain-scale annotations for marker_bin_enrichment.py --annotation-manifest.
#   label<TAB>path_or_url
# WHY DOMAIN-SCALE.  At a 250 kb bin the test is COVERAGE of the bin, so a
# peak-scale set (enhancers, cCREs, TF peaks) covers ~0.1% of a bin and its
# coverage fraction ends up measuring gene density.  Sets worth testing at this
# width are hundreds of kb to Mb.  To use a peak-scale set anyway, turn it into
# a DENSITY track (bp-per-bin or peaks-per-bin, via bedtools) and pass it with
# --signal-track instead of here.
# ALREADY AUTOMATIC.  --genome hg38 and --genome hg19 now fetch these into
# --cache-dir with no entry needed here:
#   PMD, HMD   common partially/highly methylated domains, Zhou et al. Nat
#              Genet 2018.  The 6-column file is split by class, so PMD and HMD
#              are tested separately rather than as their union.
#   ChromHMM   full-stack 100-state segmentation (Vu & Ernst, Genome Biol 2021),
#              hg38 lifted over by the authors, collapsed to ~16 biological
#              groups via the state annotation CSV.  ~39 MB, cached after the
#              first run.
#   LAD        hg19 only (UCSC laminB1Lads, Guelen et al. Nature 2008).
#   CpG islands, cytoBand Giemsa bands, GENCODE genes, GO/KEGG.
# Anything that fails to download is reported and skipped, so a stale line here
# will not stop a run.
# UCSC carries the LaminB1 table for hg19 only.  For hg38, scripts/
# fetch_4dn_damid.py pulls the 4DN LaminB1 DamID-seq bigWigs (250 kb, dam-only
# normalised, replicate mean) for 7 cell types and writes both forms:
#   python scripts/fetch_4dn_damid.py --output-dir lad_hg38 --derive-lad-bed
#   signal_track_flags.txt  the bigWigs as --signal-track (PREFERRED: the score
#                           is log2(Dam-LaminB1/Dam), so >0 is lamina-proximal
#                           and a threshold throws that gradient away).  Use
#                           --normalize zscore, not log2-median -- it is signed.
#   annotation_manifest.tsv cLAD / fLAD / ciLAD as BEDs, for when a discrete
#                           partition is wanted.  cLAD shrinks as cell types
#                           are added, so these are not comparable across runs
#                           with different --cell-type lists.
# NOT LADs: the same 4DN collection has nucleolar-targeting DamID (NADs).  They
# overlap LADs substantially but are a different compartment; the fetcher keeps
# LaminB1-Dam only.
# None of the 7 cell types is meningeal.  cLAD is the cross-cell-type invariant
# part and travels; per-cell-type tracks do not.
# From Hi-C in a relevant line (4DN).  Meningioma arises from arachnoid cap
# cells, so a mesenchymal/fibroblast reference is nearer than a neuronal one.
# compartment_A
# compartment_B
# GISTIC peaks from a published meningioma cohort.  READ THE CNV CAVEAT FIRST:
# celltype_marker_bins.py --cnv-seg tests whether a contrast is copy number
# rather than biology, and a hit here is uninterpretable until that passes.
# meningioma_del
# meningioma_amp
